title: Smoke Point in Co-flow Experiment (SPICE)
objectives: Identify smoke-point properties of nonbuoyant laminar jet diffusion flames, including the effect of burner diameter and coflow velocity on luminous flame length and smoke onset.
approach: Study laminar coflow diffusion flames under microgravity and analogous ground conditions. Systematically change burner diameter and coflow velocity and analyze flame length and smoking behavior; NASA reports 526 flames studied. **The dedicated Approach field was not present in the accessible PSI text; this is a methodology summary based on the objectives.**
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
